correctness.rationale: The endomorphism matrix form is derived from orders of cyclic generators. Reduction to the diagonal residue fields gives the radical, since its kernel is nilpotent by an exact cornerwise valuation argument. Each corner valuation of J^k is the minimum weight of a length-k walk in W=((1,0),(b-a,1)); single-corner products attain all minima and additive generation proves equality. Comparing the cost of a pair of crossings with two loops yields the complete case formulas. Cardinalities follow from orders of p-power ideals, and explicit matrices attain the sharp individual nilpotency cutoffs. The equal-exponent case is separately proved by reduction to a 2x2 matrix over F_p. Reproducible finite computations corroborate, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: Every radical power and the complete Loewy-layer cardinalities are canonical invariants of endomorphism rings of two-cyclic p-groups. The full classification determines an arithmetic phase change when the cyclic exponent gap grows from one to two. The nilpotency index of individual endomorphisms differs sharply from the radical index when the summands are equal. This is a natural ring-theoretic classification across all primes and exponent pairs, not a selected finite instance or mere normalization.
